pronunciation_overrides.Tensorblue: tˈɛnsəɹblˌu (not in the misaki lexicon; accepted CTA)

lines.text: It raced to ninety-nine percent. Now it's stuck. Why?
The bar only counted the download.
But an update still verifies the file, unpacks thousands of pieces, and installs them.
A bar shouldn't say a hundred until it's all done, so it waits.
Our test hit ninety-nine in three seconds, then sat there almost two more.
[Microsoft's](/mˈIkɹəsˌɔfts/) design guide calls that particularly uninformative and annoying.
Building one? Give every stage its share of the bar.
